title: Il reçoit des SMS envoyés par lui-même… depuis demain 📱🍐
caption:
Nico reçoit des messages de lui-même… envoyés depuis demain 📱🍐
Tu aurais ouvert la porte ? 👇
#fruits #histoire #film #suspense #pourtoi
hook: IL REÇOIT DES SMS DE DEMAIN

nico.look: A young man whose head is entirely replaced by a giant glossy green pear with big expressive cartoon eyes, eyebrows and a mouth on the fruit, no human head, no hair, wearing a black sweater and jeans.

samia.look: A young woman whose head is entirely replaced by a giant glossy red strawberry with green leaves on top with big expressive cartoon eyes, eyebrows and a mouth on the fruit, no human head, no hair, wearing a white blouse.

buraliste.look: A chubby middle-aged shopkeeper whose head is entirely replaced by a giant glossy orange with big expressive cartoon eyes, eyebrows and a mouth on the fruit, no human head, no hair, wearing a grey cardigan.

patron.look: An older businessman whose head is entirely replaced by a giant glossy shiny red apple with big expressive cartoon eyes, eyebrows and a mouth on the fruit, no human head, no hair, wearing a dark navy suit and red tie.

shots.text: Attends. Ce message vient de moi. Et il est daté de demain.
shots.scene: He sits on an unmade bed in a small Paris bedroom in the morning, staring in shock at a glowing smartphone in his hand.

shots.text: Il dit : ne prends surtout pas le bus de huit heures.
shots.scene: Close-up, he holds the smartphone near his face in a small Paris bedroom, worried, morning light from the window.

shots.text: Nico, t'as vu ? Le bus de huit heures a pris feu sur l'autoroute !
shots.scene: She stands in a bright open space office with computers, holding a phone, shocked, mouth open.
He sits at his desk in a bright open space office, smiling slyly, arms crossed.

shots.text: Nouveau message : joue le sept, le quatorze et le trente-deux.
shots.scene: He walks on a Paris street with cafes, looking at his smartphone, surprised.

shots.text: Monsieur, vous avez les trois bons numéros. C'est le gros lot !
shots.scene: He stands behind the counter of a small French tobacco shop full of lottery tickets, amazed, holding a ticket.
He stands in a small French tobacco shop, grinning and holding a lottery ticket.

shots.text: Nico, comment tu fais pour avoir toujours raison ?
shots.scene: He stands in a luxury office with big windows over Paris, puzzled, hands open.

shots.text: Disons que je vois un peu l'avenir.
shots.scene: He wears a new elegant suit in a luxury office with big windows over Paris, confident smile.

shots.text: Alors à partir de demain, c'est toi le directeur.
shots.scene: He shakes hands proudly in a luxury office with big windows over Paris, Eiffel Tower in the distance.

shots.text: Une semaine. Il m'a fallu une seule semaine pour tout avoir.
shots.scene: He relaxes on a leather sofa in a huge luxury apartment living room at night with a chandelier, happy.

shots.text: Encore un message. Mais celui-là est bizarre.
shots.scene: He sits on a leather sofa in a dark luxury apartment at night, frowning at his glowing smartphone.

shots.text: Il dit : surtout, n'ouvre pas la porte.
shots.scene: Close-up, his face lit only by a smartphone screen in a dark apartment at night, terrified.

shots.text: Qui est là, à cette heure-ci ?
shots.scene: He stands in a dark apartment hallway at night facing the front door, scared, leaning back.

shots.text: C'est moi, Nico. Ouvre. Il faut que je te parle de demain.
shots.scene: A closed wooden apartment front door at night, a thin line of light under the door, dark and mysterious
